modifiers.value: A Behemoth Army must have at least 1 Heavy Support choice for every 1000pts.

rules.name: Overwhelming Ferocity
rules.description: A Behemoth Army must have at least 1 Heavy Support choice for every 1000pts.

modifiers.value: A Kraken army must include more Fast Attack choices than Heavy Support choices.

rules.name: Speedy Consumption
rules.description: A Kraken army must include more Fast Attack Choices than Heavy Support choices.

modifiers.value: A Jourmangandr army must have more Elite choices than Heavy Support choices.

rules.name: The Enemy Below
rules.description: A Jourmangandr army must have more Elite choices than Heavy Support choices.

modifiers.value: A Hydra army must have 3 Troops choices for every 1000pts.

rules.name: The Many Headed Beast
rules.description: A Hydra army must have 3 Troops choices for every 1000pts.

rules.name: Sustainable Consumption
rules.description: If a Gorgon army does not slay more units than the opponent by the end of the game, you lose 1VP.

modifiers.value: Your army must include more Assault units than it does Feeder units.

rules.name: Bio Titan Leader
rules.description: Friendly Tyranid Behemoth Monsters within 12” of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of a 1.

rules.name: Horrific Knight
rules.description: If this unit is in your army and is your Warlord, its Synapse special rule affects the entire battlefield.

rules.name: Psychic Absorption
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, each time this unit kills any enemy models with a Psychic Power, it heals 1 wound. This stacks with Spirit Leech. If this unit kills a Psyker, it learns all Psychic Powers and Psychic Weapons known by the enemy Psyker.

rules.name: Alpha Creature
rules.description: Even if this unit is not your Warlord, it may take 1 Warlord trait from the Warlord traits section. This unit has no set Warlord trait if it is your Warlord.

rules.name: The Parasite
rules.description: Each time this unit attacks in the combat phase, after resolving all of this unit's attacks, if it inflicted at least 1 wound, you may summon 1 unit of Ripper Swarms within 3” of this unit. In addition, once per game, at the start of your movement phase, this unit may summon 1 unit of Ripper Swarms within 3” of it and more than 3” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Allegiance: Kraken
Swallow Whole
rules.description: At initiative step 0, you can select a single enemy Infantry model within 1” of a Red Terror model in this unit. It makes a toughness test. Roll a Dice. If the result is higher than the target's Toughness (T) Characteristic, it is slain and removed from play. If the result is lower than the target's Toughness characteristic, nothing happens. This counts as an Instant Death Wound.

rules.name: Allegiance: Leviathan
Invisible Stalker
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all attacks made against the Deathleaper are made at Ballistic Skill (BS) and Weapon Skill (WS) 1

sharedRules.name: Tail Weapon
sharedRules.description: A weapon with this special rule makes 1 Attack at initiative step 0 of the Combat Phase before resolving combat and determining who won combat. Wounds inflicted by this weapon count for combat resolution.

sharedRules.name: Synapse
sharedRules.description:
This special rule confers the following effects:
○ Friendly Tyranid units within 12” of a Tyranid unit with this special rule have the Stubborn special rule and change their Leadership (LD) Characteristic to 10 unless higher.
○ Friendly Tyranid Units within Synapse automatically Rally at the start of their movement phase.
○ Tyranid Units that are not within Synapse range of a model with this special rule have the Frenzy Special Rule instead and use their base Leadership (LD) Characteristic.
○ The unit with this special rule gains the Synapse keyword.
○ Tyranid units with this rule gain the benefits of the Deny the Witch and Adamantium Will special rules.

sharedRules.name: The Swarm Descends
sharedRules.description: Units instead of setting to Overwatch, may set to Counter charge. At the end of your opponent’s Charge Phase, after all charges have been declared and resolved. Any unit that set to Counter charge may attempt to charge as if it were your charge phase but with -2 to the Charge roll.

sharedRules.name: Caustic Blood
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this adaptation is slain and the last model in the unit is removed from play, before that model is removed, all enemy units within 6” take D3+(x) automatic hits where (x) is the models Wounds (W) characteristic. The Strength of the hit is equal to the removed units Toughness (T) characteristic. The AP is resolved at AP5.

sharedRules.name: Brood Cluster
sharedRules.description: During deployment, each model in a unit with this special rule is treated as an individual unit for all purposes.

sharedRules.name: Adrenal Glands
sharedRules.description: A unit with this Adaptation gains the Sprint (1) special rule. Units that already have the Sprint (x) special rule increase the value of (x) by 1.

sharedRules.name: Toxin Sacs
sharedRules.description: All units with this Adaptation gain the Poison (4+) special rule on all weapons they are equipped with. If the unit already has the Poison (x) special rule this is increased by 1 to a max of Poison (3+).

sharedRules.name: Spine Launcher
sharedRules.description: the number of attacks this weapon has under X is equal to the Attack (A) characteristic of the equipped model.

sharedRules.name: Hyper Aggression
sharedRules.description: Behemoth units gain the Rage special rule.

sharedRules.name: Synaptic Chain
sharedRules.description: If a Leviathan unit with the Synapse special rule is slain, and removed from play, any Leviathan unit within 6” of the slain unit not currently effected by Synapse must immediately make a Pinning test.

sharedRules.name: Synaptic Focus
sharedRules.description: Leviathan units in Synapse gain the Preferred Enemy special rule.

sharedRules.name: Burrow Ambush
sharedRules.description: Jourmangandr Monster & Infantry units that are not equipped with Wings gain the Deep Strike special rule. The turn a Jourmangandr unit without Wings arrives from Deep Strike, it gains the Sudden Strike special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Swarm
sharedRules.description: At the start of combat, at initiative step 10, if a Hydra Hormagaunt Brood, Ripper Swarm, or Termagant Brood unit has more models in its unit than enemy models in all engaged units, they gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic. Ripper Swarms models count as 4 models for this special rule.

sharedRules.name: Hyper Adaptive Biology
sharedRules.description: Once per game, at the start of the Battle Round, you may change which Adaptive Physiology your army benefits from (see army special rules).

sharedRules.name: The Deepest Shadow
sharedRules.description: Kronos units gain the Adamantium Will and Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rules.

sharedRules.name: The Shadow Hunt
sharedRules.description: Kronos units must attempt to charge any units with the Psyker (x) rule or units with models with the Psyker (x) rule in them if they are eligible to charge in the charge Phase unless another unit is closer.

sharedRules.name: Questing Tendrils
sharedRules.description: Kraken units gain the Crusader special rule.

sharedRules.name: Psychic Barrier
sharedRules.description: This unit has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Brood Guard
sharedRules.description: This unit may join units of Tyrant Guard even though they do not have the Monster type. If this unit is equipped with Wings, it may not join Tyrant Guard units but may join units of Gargoyles instead.

sharedRules.name: Lightning-Fast Reaction
sharedRules.description: This unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Allegiance: Behemoth
Hyper Warp Field
sharedRules.description: This unit has a 3+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Spirit leech
sharedRules.description: If this unit slays an enemy model with a psychic power or Psychic weapon, select a single friendly Tyranid model within 18” to heal 1 wound. This ability can only be used to heal 1 wound per Phase.

sharedRules.name: Warp Siphon
sharedRules.description: This unit can select 1 friendly Tyranid unit within 18” at the start of the Shooting Phase that has the Psyker (x) special rule. The target unit may not cast any Psychic Powers or Psychic weapons this Shooting Phase. This unit gains +6” to the range of its Warp Blast Psychic Weapon and +2 to its Warp Blasts Strength Characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Chameleonic
sharedRules.description: Enemy units may not target a model with this special rule in the Shooting Phase unless it is closest enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Pheromone Trail
sharedRules.description: While this unit is on the board, any Tyranid units placed in reserves via Outflank have +1 to the roll to determine if a unit will arrive.

sharedRules.name: Toxic Miasma
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 3” of this unit reduce their Toughness (T) characteristic by 1.

sharedRules.name: Shrouding Spores
sharedRules.description: This unit and any unit within 12” gain the benefits of Light Cover. If a unit is already gaining the benefit of Light Cover, they gain the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.

sharedRules.name: Suicidal Explosive
sharedRules.description: When you attack with this weapon, place a Blast marker over this attacking model. The attack automatically scores a hit for each model within 2" of this model. After resolving the attack, remove the equipped model. It is slain.

sharedRules.name: Living Ammunition
sharedRules.description: This unit cannot contest objectives or count for scoring VP. Models in his unit have a 3” Movement (M) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Tunnelling Horror
sharedRules.description: At the end of your movement phase, if this unit is on the board, you may remove it from play and place it in Deep Strike Reserves. The unit may not leave the battlefield the same turn it arrives.

sharedRules.name: Terror from the Deep
sharedRules.description: This unit does not Scatter when arriving via Deep Strike.

sharedRules.name: Will of the Hive Mind
sharedRules.description: Friendly Tyranid units that can draw visibility to this unit can re-roll failed Pinning and Panic tests.

sharedRules.name: Singular Purpose
sharedRules.description: This unit may re-roll failed hit rolls of 1 against the enemy Warlord. If the Enemy Warlord is slain by this unit, you gain 1 Victory Point. If this unit is slain, you lose 1 Victory Point.

sharedRules.name: Hyper Toxic Miasma
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 3” of this unit reduce their Toughness (T) characteristic by 1. In addition, at the end of each Charge Phase, each enemy unit within 12” takes D6 Automatic Wounds. Saves may be taken a normal against these wounds (except Cover Saves).

sharedRules.name: Gargantuan
sharedRules.description: If this unit suffers a wound from a Weapon with the Force special rule that is an Instant Death wound, this unit instead takes 3 wounds.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: A model with this wargear increases their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep strike special rules.

rules.name: Spine Banks
rules.description: The model with this Wargear gains +1 to the number of Hammer of Wrath Attacks it has.

rules.name: Tusks
rules.description: A model equipped with Tusks may re-roll Hammer of Wrath Attacks.

rules.name: Desiccator Larva
rules.description: Select a unit equipped with Fleshborer or Fleshborer Hive to receive this wargear It gains the Monster Hunter Special rule.

rules.name: Scorch Bugs
rules.description: Models with this wargear that have Fleshborer’s gain the Rending (6+) special rule. Fleshborer Hives also gain the Rending (6+) special rule.

rules.name: ElectroShock Grubs
rules.description: Models with this wargear that have Fleshborer’s gain the Haywire (6+) special rule. Fleshborer Hives also gain the Haywire (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Bio Plasma
rules.description: A model with this wargear makes D3 Hammer of Wrath (x) attacks instead of (x). If the value of (x) is greater than 1 it makes D3+1.

rules.name: Enhanced Senses
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic and the Firing Protocol (All) special rule.

rules.name: Spore Cysts
rules.description: A model with this wargear always gains the benefit of Light Cover, if the unit is would already benefit from Light Cover, it gains the benefits of Heavy Cover.

rules.name: Chitin
rules.description: Even the most basic Tyranid organisms have tough leathery hides and thin Armoured bone plates that afford them some protection against small arms fire. This confers a 6+ save.

rules.name: Reinforced Chitin
rules.description: The plates of creatures with this kind of flesh exude a constant resin-like substance that hardens quickly creating a hardened layer of ablative Armour. This confers a 5+ save.

rules.name: Armoured Shell
rules.description: The largest organisms akin to walking tanks have Armoured shells with a consistency to Armoured ceramite that absorb impacts and heat. It confers a 2+ save.

rules.name: Bonded Exoskeleton
rules.description: The bone plates and chitin have fused with the bones of the creature to form a virtually impenetrable sheath. It confers a 3+ save.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: Indirect Fire, Ignores Cover, Blast, Variable

rules.name: Alien Cunning
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this warlord trait, you can select up to 2 friendly Tyranid units in your army before deployment. They gain the Scout Special rule.

rules.name: Heightened Senses
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait can always set to Overwatch, even if it makes shooting attacks in the shooting phase. In addition, the unit gains the Night Vision special rule.

rules.name: Synaptic Linchpin
rules.description: Extend the range of the Synapse rule a model with this Warlord Trait by +6”. If they do not have the Synapse rule, they gain the Synapse special rule.

rules.name: Extended Carapace
rules.description: A model with extended Carapace has a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Acid Maw
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Sunder special rule on all Melee type weapons they are equipped with.

constraints.message: {unit} must have at least one fleshborer or fleshborer hive equipped to take {this}

rules.name: Flesh Hooks
rules.description: If a unit includes 1 or more models equipped with this wargear, the unit ignores the penalties for Charging through Difficult Terrain.

rules.name: Hardened Carapace
rules.description: The creature's Carapace is made of a thicker hardened chitin that is resistant to impacts and is far denser. It confers a 4+ save.

rules.name: Brood Telepathy
rules.description: This unit can only join units of Genestealer Broods.

rules.name: Spine Maw
rules.description: At the end of the Combat Phase, select a single enemy infantry type model within 1” of this model. The chosen unit must make a Strength test. To make a Strength test, roll a D6 and compare the result to the models Strength (S) characteristic. If the result is lower than the models Strength (S) characteristic, the test is passed, and the model resists being placed in the maw. If the result tis higher than the models Strength (S) characteristic, the target model is slain. This counts as an Instant death wound.

rules.name: Symbiotic Targeting
rules.description: If this unit remained stationary in the previous movement phase, improve its Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic by 1 (to 4) in the following shooting phase.

rules.name: Spore Mine Cysts
rules.description: Once per game, at the start of the shooting phase, this unit can summon 1 unit of Spore Mines within 12” of it.

rules.name: Sonic Screech
rules.description: At the start of the Fight Sequence, roll a dice. On a 3+, All enemy units in the combat are reduced to initiative 1.

rules.name: Circling Span
rules.description: The Harridan unit may Retreat in the Movement Phase and Charge in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This unit can transport 20 Gargoyle models.

entryLinks.name: Acid Spray
entryLinks.comment: todo: Bio-Acid Spray, No profile provided in reference

rules.name: Soft Underbelly
rules.description: If a unit directly under the Bio Titan makes an attack either in shooting or being declared an engaged target per the Titanic Strides special rule, so long as the attacking model is directly under the Bio Titan, any attacks against the Bio Titan are resolved as if the Bio Titan had an armour save of ‘–‘.

rules.name: Titanic Strides
rules.description: The unit may Retreat in the Movement Phase and still shoot and charge in the Shooting and Charge Phases at full Ballistic Skill (BS). This unit counts as being engaged if enemy units are within 3” of any of its legs. Units directly under it do not count as being engaged unless the controlling player of this unit wishes them to be. This unit may move over enemy units during the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Swarmlord
rules.description: A Hive Tyrant with this upgrade becomes the Swarmlord. The unit increases its Psyker (x) special rule by 1 and exchanges its 2 Monsterous Scything Talons for 2 Bone Sabres. The unit gains the Battle-Hardened special rule and +1 to its Wounds (W) and Attacks (A) characteristics. The Swarmlord gains the Unique Keyword (cannot take Relics or Warlord Traits).

selectionEntryGroups.name: 2 Monstrous Scything Talons
selectionEntryGroups.comment: todo: Division of options makes no sense

rules.name: Neurogaunts
rules.description: A unit that is upgraded to be Neurogaunts gain the Synapse special rule. Additionally, the unit has -1 to its Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics.

rules.name: Neuro-Lictor
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains the Psyker (1), Deny the Witch and Indomitable Spirit (5+) special rules.

infoLinks.name: Terror from the Deep
infoLinks.comment: todo: No way for unit to take provided in reference

infoLinks.name: Tunnelling Horror
infoLinks.comment: todo: No way for unit to take provided in reference

rules.name: Synapse Nodes
rules.description: Each time this unit suffers a Perils of the Warp, you may remove a Neuroloid model from this unit instead. Neuroloids cannot cast Psychic Powers. The Nueroloids do not count for majority Weapon Skill (WS) and Toughness (T) characteristic for this unit.

rules.name: Synapse Conduit
rules.description: This unit has a Synapse range of 18” instead of 12”.

rules.name: Prey Grasp
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a unit equipped with this special rule may not make Retreat moves in the Movement phase. If a unit in combat with this unit would fail a Panic test at the end of the Combat phase, the unit does not move and instead, simply takes 1 automatic wound. When a unit with this special rule attempts to charge a unit hit by this models Toxinjector Harpoon, this unit has +1 to its Charge roll.

rules.name: Psychoclastic Torrent
rules.description: A model with this wargear and any friendly Tyranid unit within 12” may not be targeted by enemy Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons. This unit always gains the benefit of Light Cover. If it would already benefit from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.

rules.name: Tremoscythe Strain
rules.description: Enemy units may not arrive from reserves within 12” of a model with this upgrade.

rules.name: Felltalon Strain
rules.description: A model upgraded to a Felltaln Strain gains the Poison (4+) special rule on all equipped Melee weapons.

rules.name: Wrecker Strain
rules.description: A model with this upgrade has a 3+ Armor Save.

rules.name: Burrowed Bio form
rules.description: Models in this unit cannot perform Movement actions in the Movement Phase and may not declare Charges in the Charge Phase. The Sporocyst cannot Panic from losing combat and perform Fall Back moves.

rules.name: Spawn Termagants
rules.description: At the start of each of your Movement Phases, an attached unit of Termagants regains D3+1 models. Instead of setting to Overwatch, the Tervigon may set to spawn instead. At the end of your opponent’s next charge phase, you may select 1 Termagant unit within 12” or attached to this unit. The target unit regains an additional D3+1 Termagant models.

rules.name: Brood progenitor
rules.description: This unit may join units of Termagants even though it does not have the Infantry type.

rules.name: Trygon Prime
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains the Synapse special rule and a 5+ Invulnerable Save.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This unit can transport 20 Infantry models. Alternatively, this unit can Transport 1 Monster type unit that does not have the Fly keyword or a Wounds (W) characteristic of 5 or more. If the Monster unit has a special rule that allows you to take multiple models in the unit that would separate upon deployment, all the models from that unit may be placed in this Transport during deployment and separate to become individual units once they Disembark. Models may not Embark on this unit after Deployment is completed. When this unit arrives via Deep Strike, units Embarked must Disembark. It may not transport Hierophant Bio Titans or Hierodule Broods.

rules.name: Blind Rampage
rules.description: If a friendly Hive Tyrant in your army is slain, this unit must attempt to always charge the nearest target for the rest of the game. In addition, this unit gains the Rage special rule.

rules.name: Neurothrope
rules.description: A model with this upgrade gains +1 to its Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics. In addition, the model gains the Spirit Leech and Warp Siphon Special rules.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a bonesword or monstrous bonesword equipped to take {this}

rules.name: The Resonance Barb
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains the Psyker (1) special rule. If the unit already has the Psyker (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1. In addition, when attempting to cast a Psychic Power, you can re-roll 1 of the D6 for your Psychic test.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have schything talons or monstrous scything talons equipped to take {this}

rules.name: The Norn Crown
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains the Synapse Special rule. If they already have the Synapse special rule, they gain +6” to the range of Synapse.

rules.name: The Maw-Claws of Thyrax
rules.description: At the end of each Combat Phase, if the model with this Relic inflicted an unsaved Wound on an enemy model, it Heals 1 Wound.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have a venom cannon or heavy venom cannon equipped to take {this}

rules.name: Gestation Sac
rules.description: Once per battle, a model equipped with this Relic can summon 1 unit of Ripper Swarms anywhere on the Battlefield within 3” of this unit.

rules.name: Onslaught
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target unit may Advance in the Movement Phase and Shoot its weapons in the Shooting Phase with -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Dominion
rules.description: When this power is cast, All Tyranids on the battlefield count as being in Synapse for the purposes of the Synapse special rule until the Start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Catalyst
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24” of the Psyker, it gains the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Psychic Scream
rules.description: When this power is cast, each enemy units within 12" of the Psyker take D6 Strength User, AP 5 Pinning automatic hits.

rules.name: The Horror
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That unit immediately makes a Pinning Test with -2 to its Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Paroxysm
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That unit halves its Initiative (I) Characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
